name: ArabUT Coins Pricing v2.1 - Adaptive FFT + UTT Carry Forward

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: All tunable economics, tier and stability values live here. v2.2 uses environment-backed provider credentials.

nodes.name: Probe FFT
nodes.notes: v2.2: adaptive cycle + targeted pricing; detects HTTP-200 provider errors; riskLevel=10.

nodes.name: Probe UTT
nodes.notes: v2.2: documented flat stockSection, no minimum-average filter, theoretical startCoins, monotonic binary search.

nodes.name: Prepare Coins Snapshot
nodes.notes: Optimized: cached multiplier maps, one-time anchor parsing, O(1) boundary-aware multiplier lookup, compact output.

nodes.name: Validate Snapshot
nodes.notes: Optimized: O(1) boundary-aware multiplier lookup, full 8,373-price validation from each group minimum, compact output and duration metric.

nodes.name: Evaluate Publish Result
nodes.notes: Confirms apply/replay, updates stability baseline, and returns a compact result without duplicating the snapshot.

nodes.name: Success Summary
nodes.notes: Compact terminal summary; the full signed snapshot was already sent to Laravel.

nodes.name: Assess Price Move
nodes.notes: Flags a move only when it is BOTH >25% and >10 SAR. No cap is applied.

nodes.name: Request Telegram Approval
nodes.notes: Pauses the run until the owner answers. Set a wait limit in Settings.

nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Requires Workflow Settings -> Error Workflow to point at this workflow.

nodes.name: Telegram Failure Alert
nodes.notes: No onError override: an undelivered alert leaves a red execution.
